question: In which of the following states is India’s first moss garden being developed?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttarakhand__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first moss Garden is being developed in **Uttarakhand.**
 
• This Moss Garden is being developed in Nainital District.
 
• Moss Garden situated in Nainital is the country's first moss garden spread over 10 hectares.
 
• This Garden is an interpretation center, 3with 0 representative moss species, and other bryophyte species, including two species listed on IUCN Red List and a moss trail nearly 1.25 km long.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Famous Gardens of India:__**

 
 
• ​Shalimar Bagh and Nishat Bagh, Kashmir.
 
• Hanging Gardens, Mumbai.
 
• Lal Bagh Garden, Bengaluru.
 
• Rock Garden, Chandigarh.
 
• Company Bagan, Kolkata.
 
• Yadavindra Gardens, Pinjore.
 
• Chaubatia, Ranikhet.
 
• Tulip Garden, Srinagar.
